title: baseline.reproduced (v1)
description: RunnerAgent has finished attempting to reproduce the baseline and frozen a BaselineResult into the Research Store (see agents/runner_agent/data-contracts/baseline_result.schema.yaml). Payload is intentionally minimal: the result is read from the Research Store by ref. RunnerAgent itself is out of scope for this task (M10) -- this is the frozen contract only; no consumer wired yet.

verdict.description: RunnerAgent's verdict on whether the baseline was successfully reproduced.

baseline_result_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen BaselineResult object.

benchmark_id.description: Identifier of the benchmark whose baseline was (attempted to be) reproduced, mirroring BenchmarkSpec.benchmark_id.
